title: 第97章 锦衣入沪，林家人自己的底气
content_zh:
第97章 锦衣入沪，林家人自己的底气-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

上一章

下一章

虹桥别墅的灯亮得很早。

车刚停稳，院门已经打开。

保姆站在门廊下，司机把后备箱里的行李一件件搬下来。

园丁正在收最后一截水管，草坪修得齐整，阳光房里摆着几盆刚送来的兰草。

林建国站在院门口，脚没往里迈。

李秀兰也停住了。

她看着眼前这栋独栋别墅，又看了看林川。

“小川，这地方……真的是给我们住的？”

林川接过她手里的布袋。

“不给你们住，还能给谁住？”

林小冉从后面探头。

“妈，哥早就安排好了，不是做面子。你要是不住，他才真难受。”

李秀兰瞪她一眼。

“就你嘴快。”

话是这么说，她还是跟着进了院子。

客厅挑高，落地窗外就是小花园。

林川带着父母一间间看。

“一楼是你们的房间，晚上起夜方便。旁边有个小客厅，爸可以看报，妈可以织毛衣。”

“厨房在这边。我让人换了中式灶台，妈要是想自己做饭，也顺手。”

李秀兰走进厨房。

锅具一排排摆好，米面油盐都备齐了。

冰箱里放着新鲜蔬菜和肉，连江城常吃的腊肉都准备了几块。

她摸了摸灶台，声音压低。

“这也太铺张了。”

林川靠在门边。

“妈，咱们以前省，是因为没办法。”

李秀兰没接话。

她想起筒子楼那间小厨房。

一转身就碰到锅，一开窗就是别人家的油烟。

夏天做一顿饭，汗能把衣服浸透。

她低头擦了擦灶台。

灶台很干净。

不用擦。

林小冉已经跑上二楼挑房间。

没一会儿，她的声音从楼上传下来。

“哥！你这也太暴发户了吧！我的房间居然还有独立衣帽间！”

林川抬头。

“嫌大？”

“不嫌！”

林小冉立刻改口。

“我就是批评一下你朴素的审美。”

张虎站在客厅门口笑。

“大小姐，你这话要是让外面那些租隔断间的人听见，容易挨揍。”

林小冉哼了一声。

“虎哥你现在也是资本家的人了，少装劳动人民。”

张虎低头看了看自己晒黑的手。

“我顶多算资本家身边跑腿的劳动人民。”

客厅里笑了一阵。

林川带林建国去了书房。

书房不大。

靠窗是一张实木桌，墙上没有挂名画，只挂了几张老照片。

江城机械厂的大门。

车间里那台旧车床。

还有林建国年轻时穿着蓝色工装，站在厂门口和工人合影的照片。

林建国一进门，脚步就停了。

他盯着那几张照片，半天没说话。

林川站在旁边。

“爸，我让人回江城找的。”

林建国走近，伸手摸了摸相框。

照片里的人，有些已经退休，有些离开了厂，有些前世甚至没撑到后来。

The lights of Hongqiao Villa come on very early.

As soon as the car stopped, the courtyard door was opened.

The nanny stood under the porch while the driver unloaded the luggage from the trunk one by one.

The gardener is closing the last water pipe, the lawn is neatly trimmed, and there are several pots of freshly delivered bluegrass in the sunroom.

Lin Jianguo stood at the door of the courtyard without stepping in.

Li Xiulan also stopped.

She looked at the single-family villa in front of her, and then at Lin Chuan.

"Xiaochuan, this place...is really for us to live in?"

Lin Chuan took the bag in her hand.

"If I don't accommodate you, who else can I accommodate you?"

Lin Xiaoran poked his head from behind.

"Mom, I've made arrangements a long time ago. It's not just to save face. It would be really uncomfortable for him if you don't stay."

Li Xiulan glared at her.

"As long as you speak quickly."

Having said that, she still followed him into the courtyard.

The living room has a high ceiling, and there is a small garden outside the floor-to-ceiling window.

Lin Chuan took his parents to watch from room to room.

"The first floor is your room. It's convenient to get up at night. There is a small living room next to it. Dad can read the newspaper and mom can knit sweaters."

"The kitchen is over here. I asked someone to replace the Chinese stove. If Mom wants to cook by herself, that's fine."

Li Xiulan walked into the kitchen.

The pots and pans are arranged in rows, and the rice, noodles, oil and salt are all ready.

There are fresh vegetables and meat in the refrigerator, and even a few pieces of bacon that Jiang Cheng often eats are prepared.

She touched the stove and lowered her voice.

"This is too extravagant."

Lin Chuan leaned against the door.

"Mom, we saved it before because we had no other choice."

Li Xiulan didn't answer.

She thought of the small kitchen in Tongzilou.

When I turn around, I bump into a pot, and when I open a window, I see the fumes from someone else’s house.

If you cook a meal in summer, your clothes will be soaked with sweat.

She lowered her head and wiped the stove.

The stove is very clean.

No need to wipe.

Lin Xiaoran had already run up to the second floor to choose a room.

After a while, her voice came down from upstairs.

"Brother! You are too nouveau riche! My room actually has a separate dressing room!"

Lin Chuan raised his head.

"Too big?"

"No problem!"

Lin Xiaoran immediately changed his tune.

"I'm just criticizing your simple aesthetic."

Zhang Hu stood at the door of the living room and smiled.

"Miss, if you let the people renting partition rooms outside hear what you said, you will easily get beaten."

Lin Xiaoran snorted.

"Brother Hu, you are now a capitalist, so stop pretending to be a working person."

Zhang Hu looked down at his tanned hands.

"At best, I can be considered a working person running errands around the capitalists."

There was a laugh in the living room.

Lin Chuan took Lin Jianguo to the study.

The study is not big.

There is a solid wood table by the window. There are no famous paintings on the wall, only a few old photos.

The gate of Jiangcheng Machinery Factory.

The old lathe in the workshop.

There are also photos of Lin Jianguo when he was young, wearing blue work clothes, standing at the factory gate and taking photos with workers.

As soon as Lin Jianguo entered the door, his footsteps stopped.

He stared at the photos and said nothing for a long time.

Lin Chuan stood beside him.

"Dad, I asked someone to go back to Jiangcheng to find him."

Lin Jianguo approached and reached out to touch the photo frame.

Some of the people in the photo have retired, some have left the factory, and some did not even survive until later in their previous lives.
